descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · UAT TC-03 step 6, ER; TFA-92581 AC 3 · “Nursing Home: search returns correct results independently for name, unit/room, MRN, and facility”.

Approach · TC-03 Search & Sort · S03 Nursing Home search by name, unit/room and MRN in Today's Visits and All Residents

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U4 Nursing Home: search by name, by unit/room, by MRN and by facility each returns the correct matching residents, each field on its own. (UAT TC-03; TFA-92581 AC 3; TFA-92581 AC 6)

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given One resident whose name, unit or MRN holds a unique token; on today's list (today tests) or only in All Residents (all tests)

When Type part of the token, then a no-match string, then Clear search

Then The resident is found by each field in both views; the no-match string lists nobody; Clear restores the list

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright assertions as in S01 (U4 name, unit/room, MRN). No existing test covers facility (S10). The 'Nursing Home today/all: search independently by diagnosis' tests are left out on purpose: they assert NH diagnosis IS searchable, the opposite of AC 3 (see S07). Needs precondition P1

Where it ran: datasets (seeded data sets, list checks) on dev; test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S03 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-03.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build 8b4be94 (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-19T17:04:37Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev, lane datasets (datasets/results.json, screenshots not attached).

Test method: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev/datasets.
